manifest.method: Canonical SDK two-phase token runner; freeze before tokenizer loading and file every finite direction once.
manifest.evidentiary_limit: Current token cost of the focus weld against bare only; not comprehension or future Ainglish-aware tokenizer cost.

comparison_identity.comparator: hyphen-welded only-<focus> versus bare only at the identical focus site
comparison_identity.population: 32 fresh sentences balanced eight each across subject, verb, object-nominal and adjunct focus
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal item mean per stratum, equal stratum mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean

estimand_contract_policy.reason: the replication target declares no estimand_contract; a one-sided unit_span is held by the register (incommensurable hold: unit), so the design declaration is kept in plan.design_declaration and the mint estimand, not in the manifest

design_declaration.contrast: hyphen-welded only-<focus> versus bare only at the identical focus site
design_declaration.population: 32 fresh sentences balanced eight each across subject, verb, object-nominal and adjunct focus

aggregation.rule: equal item mean per stratum, equal stratum mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean

mint.estimand: token_delta over complete sentence: hyphen-welded only-<focus> versus bare only at the identical focus site; population: 32 fresh sentences balanced eight each across subject, verb, object-nominal and adjunct focus; aggregation: equal item mean per stratum, equal stratum mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
